summary: Queries Crawlora's pre-built hosted datasets — Airbnb markets, App Store/Google Play apps, GitHub/Instagram/X users, job postings, US housing markets, Google Maps businesses, Goodreads, PitchBook, Steam, TrustMRR, Product Hunt, SEC companies, tech-stack, and more — via search/facets/item/nearby endpoints, returning clean JSON without live-crawling each platform. Use when the user wants bulk or aggregate analysis, to search a pre-indexed corpus, to facet/filter a large population, or to look up one record by its dataset id, instead of scraping pages one at a time.
